data.narrative:
Mindgrove Technologies is a Series A-stage semiconductor company that has raised ₹85 Cr (~$10M) to date. Valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 3 public semiconductor benchmarks (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private-stage comparables, with particular relevance from same-sector, same/adjacent-stage peers including Rebellions ($2.3B Series A), d-Matrix ($2.0B Series A), and Positron AI ($1.0B Series B).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier to the $10M raised proxy, implying a $20M valuation. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector comparables yields a $2.0B implied valuation, with a observed range of $1.0B–$2.3B. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (median 18.9x across the 3 public tickers) cannot be applied due to absence of target revenue disclosure. 

Triangulating these two applicable methods produces a valuation range of $17M (low) to $2.3B (high), with a median of $1.0B. The substantial spread reflects tension between stage-based progression from capital deployed and peer-market comparables in an active, high-valuation segment. Key uncertainties include Mindgrove's technology differentiation relative to peers and revenue traction post-Series A, both of which would narrow the range materially.
